semiconductor_relevance: High — KeZhe(Shanghai)Valves Co.,Ltd specializes in stainless steel valves for electronic specialty gases, which are critical components in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: KeZhe(Shanghai)Valves Co.,Ltd develops and manufactures stainless steel valves specifically designed for the semiconductor and specialty gas industries. The company focuses on R&D to provide localized solutions for electronic specialty gases, addressing a market that has traditionally relied on imported products.
capabilities: Stainless steel valves for inert gases such as nitrous oxide and helium
Valves for corrosive and hazardous gases including hydrogen chloride and phosphine
R&D for electronic specialty gas applications

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Jinshan District, Shanghai, and has established itself as a key player in the local market for semiconductor-related components.
